candidate.answerReason: The product has the same last four digits as 303 × 505 = 153015, namely 3015. Thus A = 3, B = 5, and A + B = 8.

methods.label: Keep only the last four digits
methods.explanation:
The thousands and units digits are both among the last four digits, so we need only that ending of the product. The two factors end in \(0303\) and \(0505\).

Everything to the left of a factor's last four digits represents a multiple of \(10{,}000\). Any partial product involving that part is also a multiple of \(10{,}000\), so it cannot change the product's last four digits. We may therefore calculate just
\[
303\times505=151{,}500+1{,}515=153{,}015.
\]
Its last four digits are \(3015\). Hence the thousands digit is \(A=3\), the units digit is \(B=5\), and
\[
A+B=3+5=\boxed{8},
\]
choice \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
